articles.summary: CINCINNATI – The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) will report third-quarter 2026 operating results after the markets close on Thursday, Nov. 5. The call with the company’s senior management team will take place at 9:30 a.m. Eastern time on Friday, Nov. 6.
articles.title: Scripps to release third-quarter 2026 operating results on Nov. 5
